test.name: Init-flavored 'start research' on an existing project must not re-init
test.description: The user says 'start research' — wording that is an explicit init-project trigger phrase — but a research.json already exists in the folder. The refuse-if-exists guard must hold against init-flavored wording (not just the 'add a question' phrasing covered by ut_init_project_003) and route to a research skill rather than re-running init.

negative.explanation: A research.json already exists (mid-research-flynn). init-project only creates a brand-new project from scratch; its guard clause refuses when research.json is present. Even though 'start research' is an init-project trigger phrase, the refuse-if-exists invariant must hold and route the user to the research skill (which reviews existing-project state) or question-selection (which picks the next question). The skill must NOT re-run the initialization workflow or call person_read/person_search. GRADED ON THE INVARIANT from 2026-10-07: the invariant this test guards is that init-project REFUSES when research.json exists; `test_existing_project_is_not_reinitialized` enforces that mechanically (no person_read, person_search or project_create), so grading on the invariant is not vacuous — _compute_outcome only reaches the invariant branch once validators pass. correct_skill is kept so the reciprocity lint still reads these edges.

judge_context: Should decline to initialize (research.json already exists) and route to the research skill (which reviews the existing project's state) or question-selection (next-question wording), not re-run the init workflow
Should make no MCP tool calls — no person_read, no person_search, no place_search

Judge the routing decision and the absence of init work only. Once the run routes, the harness stops it and `text_response` is empty, so there is no decline wording to weigh here — the guard clause's literal one-line text is not gradable on this test and must not be scored as present or absent.
